comparison.objective: Extract one locked terminal; record selectively harvests ripe tomatoes.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid recessed-tab manipulation versus compliant fruit grasping and bending at an abscission joint while limiting squeeze and axial stem load.
comparison.success_condition: Selected terminal out without damage or neighbor release versus both ripe tomatoes detached at their knuckles and placed in the tray while the green fruit and truss remain intact. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Both are selective detachment, but the physical mechanism—tool-released lock versus force-limited biological joint break—is meaningfully different.
